description: Get or set the seller's once-per-business answers — currency, brand accent colour, checkout template, and standard guarantee. Call with NO fields to read them. gocushy applies these AUTOMATICALLY: new products inherit the currency, and checkouts inherit accent/layout/guarantee unless the offer overrides them — so once these are set, don't re-ask the seller for currency, brand colour, template, or guarantee terms. If they're unset at the start of a selling session, offer to capture them once ('What currency do you sell in? Brand colour? Standard guarantee?').

accent.description: Brand hex colour — any shade; the checkout picks black or white button text automatically

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. usd, nzd

guarantee.description: Standard guarantee applied to every checkout unless the offer sets its own; null clears it

name: seller_defaults
title: Seller defaults
